column1: # Aliases canonical_gene must never rewrite to a panel gene, although each
# is an unambiguous >=4-character alias of one in ref/synonym_to_gene_symbol.tsv.
# Read only by utils/reference_validation.py; path in config.py.
# - observed: the alias occurs as a whole word in the cached eligibility texts
#   (cache/nct, cache/ctis; 1,255 trials) and every occurrence means something
#   other than an alteration of the gene - a disease, a document, a drug, an
#   antigen measured by IHC. A model copying it into hugo_symbol would get a
#   silent wrong criterion instead of a visible drop.
# - english: the alias is a word in /usr/share/dict/words (web2, 234,456
#   words). None of these occurred in the cached texts with this casing; they
#   are here because the only thing between them and a rewrite is case.
# Families, CD antigens, fusion names, punctuation variants of a blocked
# alias and current symbols of other genes are excluded by rule in code and
